title: Tourism Station Picker Label Fix
summary: Fixed raw i18n keys in Tourism station picker by using RailwayDB.getNameMap() reverse lookup.
root_cause: sightseeing.js used window.t(station_names.s) but no such i18n keys exist in translations.js. name_map has Japanese->English only, so reverse lookup resolves English ID to Japanese name.
fix: Added getNameMap() forward lookup then reverse lookup to resolve station ID to Japanese name.
known_limitation: Selected station display (sm-station-detected) still shows English name because getStationName returns English name from JP->EN name_map. Pre-existing, not introduced by 3.67.
